Iran President Addresses UNGA, Criticizes US Policies

Iranian President Ebrahim Pezeshkian addressed the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) on Tuesday. During his address, Pezeshkian stated that Iran is a "victim" of US "terrorism." He also referenced the Supreme Leader. His appearance at the UNGA is seen as an effort by Tehran to present its case internationally and engage in indirect diplomacy with Washington.
